tei:div.tei:p: 359)༄༅/ na moḥdakon mchog= ka dag= rang nyid shākya'i rgyal po ni: sku mdog ser po zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis phyag mtshan 'di ltar yin: g.yas pas chos 'chad g.yon pas ni: mnyam bzhag steng na lhung bzed 'dzin: sku la chos gos rnam gsum gsol: zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis ni: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs: gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan pa las: 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung gathugs yon phrin las bstod: nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags: thugs kar sa bon sngags kyis bskor: 'od 'phros don gnyis lhun grub gyur: oṃ shākya mu ne swā hā: 360)

rjes chog na/ི hūm̐/ rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// mchod cing bstod de nongs pa bshags// dngos grub kun stsol brtan par bzhugs// 'od gsal dbyings bsdu lha skur ldang*// dge bas sangs rgyas 'grub pa dang*/ bkra shigs 'dzam gling kun khyab shog pad+ma ma ṇis so// ༄༅/ phur sgrub mgon sgrub sbrel ma byed skabs/ nyin dang po/ gnam chos rtsa gsum las byang nang*/ dmigs pa rdo rje phur pa= sprad/ bsnyen pa sum brgya/ mchod bstod/ gzhan rnams/ rgyal tho btsugs 'phro'i mal/ chags med spros med drag po'i sbyin sreg sngags grangs mang*/ sbyin bsreg me de yi sa dam sri mnan pa tshar dus/ me thun chu thun/ phur pa'i bgegs bskrad dang*/ srung 'khor 'don/ sbyin sreg mtha' bsdu/ ༈ hrīḥsngon= mgon po'i dug phyung khrus/ skyabs sems nas/ phur pa'i las byang*/ bsnyen pa/ kī la ya= stong tsam/ mchod bstod/ dge bsngo bcas/ phur mjug nas/ seng gdong yan/ dngos grub 'byung gter dbu nas bsnyen pa yab sngags stong*/ yum sngags gsum brgya/ sbrel ma brgya/ sngags mtha' bar tshe bskul dbu nas/ tshe gzungs brgya/ tshe bh+rum̐ sum brgya/ mchod bstod/ bshags pa/ brtan bzhugs/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i= bdag gi mgon po khyed sgrub= rnga rdung 'don/ bkra shis/ thugs rje mnga' bdag= mtha' bar/ 'ur sum rdung*/ ma mgon lcam dral dbu nas/ skong ba tshar nyer lnga/ 'khrugs skong*/ phud bshal/ bstod pa/ mnga' gsol/ sum bcu= legs ldan/ gza'/ gnod sbyin/ srog sgrub/ rnam sras/ tshe ring*/ g.yu sgron/ ngan ne/ tsi dmar/ sprol bral chos kyi= gser skyems/ ye shes las grub= thub pa'i bstan pa= bcas/ ༈ thun gnyis pa/ 362) dngos grub 'byung gter dbu nas/ bkra shis yan/ ting 'dzin sprul pa'i= tshar nyer lnga/ gnam chos ma ning nas/ klu rgyal yan/ ༈ thun gsum pa/ dngos grub 'byung gter/ bkra shis yan/ phur pa'i tshogs/ bskang ba gzhung rgyug

ting 'dzin sprul pa'i= tshar nyer lnga/ bzlog mtha'i tshogs bskang drang lhag bcas/ ༈ thun bzhi pa/ mgon po'i gab thig bsnyen pa thun bzung*/ ༈ nub mo/ ting 'dzin sprul pa'i= tshar nyer lnga/ skong ba/ chos nyid rnam dag sde brgyad skong ba bcas/ mchod bstod bkra shis yan/ dkar tor/ rtsa rgyud= phur pa'i chad brtan sogs kyis mtha' bsdu/ de 'dra ba kho nas nyin lnga rdzogs nas/ nyin drug pa'i thun dang po'i sngags 'grigs mthar/ dngos grub bsnyen pa ci 'grub/ mchod bstod mjug tu/ oṃ/ bdud rtsi dngos grub= kyis thod chang len/ bshags pa man/ bkra shis yan dang*/ ma mgon sogs/ ༈ thun gnyis pa/ bsnyen bstod mthar/ mdun du e nag po= mar 'gros/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa'i= 'gugs pa tshar nyer gcig bden chung tshar brgya/ rtsa brgyud= gsum/ 'og gi gnad dbab sngags brgya/ bdag he ru= hūm̐/ kha kha mu kha= ya mu rbad= brgya/ gong gi 'gugs pa'i 'phros/ dgra bo 'di rgyab rten byed pa'i lha dang= sogs/ bstim cig 'og gi bdag gi thugs ka nas= sogs/ yang yang bstim= sngags nar 'don 363) sum brgya tsam/ thun mthar/ gong gi dam nyams pa'i dgra bo bros pa'i= sad cig sgrol cig= thun sngags tshar gsum/ rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ bshags pa/ mgon po 'khor bcas= sogs/ bkra shis yan/ ma ning nas/ klu rgyal yan/ ༈ thun gsum pa/ gong ltar/ tshogs bskang lhag ma/ ༈ thun bzhi pa phyi sgrub dus ltar/ ༈ nyin bdun pa/ thun dang po/ dngos grub 'byung gter smad las kha sang thun gnyis ltar/ ma mgon= sogs/ ༈ thun gnyis pa/ 'gugs pa nyung tsam/ sngags grangs rnams nyung tsam/ rbad sngags bar sngar gnyin ltar la/ sku stod= sogs mar 'gros/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum sngags tshar gsum/ yang*/ mgon po sku mchog= nas tshar gsum/ gru gsum nang du= bsad sngags brgya/ bdag nyid yi dam= byang shar pha mtha'= mar 'gros/ dza dzaḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa: bha ling+ta ta kha hiḥ lan gsum/ bsad sngags tshar nyer gcig

mdun gyi ma hā kā la= thun sngags tshar dgu/ gong gi dam nyams pa'i dgra bo sgrol ba'i= sgrol cig: bsad brdung*/ bstan dgra= nan dza dzaḥ rgyob sod/ bshags pa man/ ༈ thun gsum pa de ltar/ zhal bstab tshar nas/ sbyin bsreg gi phaṭaḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas= mar 'gros/ me lha mer gyur= bar*/ 364)me dpung chen po de yi nang du/ gab thig ltar lha bskyed nas/ bstod pa yan/ bsreg rdzas/ sngags ring nyer gcig mgon po chen po= puṣ+pe= bskal pa= bzod gsol yig brgya/ oṃ ma hā ka la sarba mu= bsdu'o: bdag gi mgon po= bkra shis bcas/ tshogs bskang*/ lhag ma'i rjes/ khang steng gser skyems/ shar phyogs dri za'i= mar 'gros/ khrag zor bh+yo: phur pa'i dug mda' le'u dang po/ chad tho/ bswo cha'o/ bh+yo bh+yo= bar/ gral du bzhugs/ brtan ma sogs mtha' bsdu'o/ ༈ nyin brgyad pa la yi dam/ gsol ka phyogs 'don/ tshogs bskang lhag ma/ mgon po'i gsol mchod rgyas pa/ tshe sgrub bsnyen bstod rjes/ ye shes mgon po rnam par snang mdzad= oṃ shrī ma hā ka la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs/ bde gshegs mgon po= bstod: mgon po 'khor bcas= bshags pa/ phyogs bcu na= rten bzhugs/ dam tshig pa rnams ma hā= sogs/ lte bar bsdu'o/ bdag gi mgon po= bkra shis bcas/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ chad brtan/ bro mnan sogs/ rgyal dkyil= bcas kyis legs par grub bo// tshig tho 'di bor ma shor dang de snga yod tshad nang 'di dga'/ zhes rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus pas so// sarba maṅga laṃ// 365)bslu med dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/ khyab bdag pad+ma thod phreng mthu byin gyis// lhag bsam dag pas smon pa'i bden tshig don// gegs med yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// mchog gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nyid// gzugs sku'i bkod pa zhi ba'i tshul bstan yang*// rtsod dus 'gro la thugs bskyed cher dgongs nas// rigs kyi dam par mngal gyi rgyar zhugs ste// bar chad med par sprul pa'i zla snang 'char// blo gros gsal zhing rnam dpyod yangs pa dang*// nga rgyal rnam spangs btul zhugs rmad du byung*// byang chub sems dpa'i snying stobs bla med cing*// rigs gsum sems dpa'i rnam thar bdag gir mdzad// tshe dpag med kyi tshe dbang grub nas kyang*// rdzogs smin sbyangs pa'i yon tan rgya mtshos phyug

/stobs bcu mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'i dbang dang ldan/ mkha' khyab 'gro la phan bde'i dga' ston dbyig /rtag khyab lhun grub phrin las mthar phyin shog ces pa'ang kun bzang theg mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// 366)
